Gur Hunter Sharpshooter is a ranger archetype of Gur.

Involvement

Gur Hunter Sharpshooter can be summoned with the  Gather Your Allies variant,  Gur Huntwardens, if the player agrees to help Ulma and the Gur recover their children and then kills Cazador without ascending Astarion. It is one of three summonable Gur alongside  Gur Hunter Warrior (Handaxe) and  Gur Hunter Warrior (Scimitar).
